hints.content:
The number lines show that the ratio of $\maroonD{\text{banjos}}$ to $\blueE{\text{percentage}}$ is $\maroonD{15}:\blueE{100\%}$.

We are looking for ratios that are equivalent to $\maroonD{15}:\blueE{100\%}$.

$\maroonD{15}\div \maroonD{3}= \purpleE{5}$

So, we can find the percentage for $\maroonD{3}$ by dividing both parts of the ratio by $\purpleE{5}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{20\%}$ of $15$ is $\maroonD{3}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Banjos, reads from left to right: 0, 3, 15. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 20 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 15 to 100 percent to the pair 3 to 20 percent is labeled divided by 5.

hints.content:
$\maroonD{6}\div\maroonD{3}=\purpleE{2}$

Now we can find the percentage for $6$ banjos by multiplying both parts of the new ratio by $\purpleE{2}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{40\%}$ of $15$ is $\maroonD{6}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 4 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Banjos, reads from left to right: 0, 3, 6, 15. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 20 percent, 40 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 3 to 20 percent to the pair 6 to 40 percent is labeled times 2.
